title: Income Statement
description: External financial-statement contract for period revenue, expenses, profit, and earnings-per-share measures.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: fs-income-statement
  title: Income Statement
  description: External financial-statement contract for extracting period revenue, expenses, profit, and earnings-per-share measures.
  version: 1.0.0
  source:
    system: ladder
    sourceId: standard-financial-services/income-statement
    sourceVersion: 1.0.0
spec:
  documentType: income_statement
  sections:
    - id: statement-identity
      title: Statement identity
      fieldIds: [entity-name, period-start-date, period-end-date, comparative-period-end-date, currency, scale, accounting-standard, audited]
    - id: operating-results
      title: Operating results
      fieldIds: [revenue, cost-of-revenue, gross-profit, operating-expenses, operating-income]
    - id: non-operating-and-net-income
      title: Non-operating items and net income
      fieldIds: [interest-expense, other-income-expense, income-before-tax, income-tax-expense, net-income]
    - id: per-share-and-detail
      title: Per-share data and detail
      fieldIds: [basic-eps, diluted-eps, line-items]
  fields:
    - id: entity-name
      name: entity_name
      label: Entity name
      description: Legal or reporting entity named on the statement.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /statement/entity_name
    - id: period-start-date
      name: period_start_date
      label: Period start date
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /statement/period_start_date
    - id: period-end-date
      name: period_end_date
      label: Period end date
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /statement/period_end_date
    - id: comparative-period-end-date
      name: comparative_period_end_date
      label: Comparative period end date
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /statement/comparative_period_end_date
    - id: currency
      name: currency
      label: Reporting currency
      description: Reporting currency, preferably represented by an ISO 4217 code when stated.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /statement/currency
    - id: scale
      name: scale
      label: Presentation scale
      description: Units, thousands, millions, or another stated presentation scale.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /statement/scale
    - id: accounting-standard
      name: accounting_standard
      label: Accounting standard
      description: GAAP, IFRS, statutory basis, or another stated basis of presentation.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /statement/accounting_standard
    - id: audited
      name: audited
      label: Audited
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /statement/audited
    - id: revenue
      name: revenue
      label: Revenue
      dataType: number
      required: true
      sourcePath: /results/revenue
    - id: cost-of-revenue
      name: cost_of_revenue
      label: Cost of revenue
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /results/cost_of_revenue
    - id: gross-profit
      name: gross_profit
      label: Gross profit
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /results/gross_profit
    - id: operating-expenses
      name: operating_expenses
      label: Operating expenses
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /results/operating_expenses
    - id: operating-income
      name: operating_income
      label: Operating income
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /results/operating_income
    - id: interest-expense
      name: interest_expense
      label: Interest expense
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /results/interest_expense
    - id: other-income-expense
      name: other_income_expense
      label: Other income or expense
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /results/other_income_expense
    - id: income-before-tax
      name: income_before_tax
      label: Income before tax
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /results/income_before_tax
    - id: income-tax-expense
      name: income_tax_expense
      label: Income tax expense
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /results/income_tax_expense
    - id: net-income
      name: net_income
      label: Net income
      dataType: number
      required: true
      sourcePath: /results/net_income
    - id: basic-eps
      name: basic_eps
      label: Basic earnings per share
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /per_share/basic_eps
    - id: diluted-eps
      name: diluted_eps
      label: Diluted earnings per share
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /per_share/diluted_eps
    - id: line-items
      name: line_items
      label: Statement line items
      description: Ordered line items with label, current-period value, comparative value, and source location when available.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /line_items
  validationRules:
    - id: entity-name-present
      severity: error
      description: The reporting entity is required.
      supported: true
      rule: { op: present, field: entity_name }
    - id: period-end-present
      severity: error
      description: The reporting period end date is required.
      supported: true
      rule: { op: present, field: period_end_date }
    - id: revenue-present
      severity: error
      description: Revenue is required for an income statement extraction.
      supported: true
      rule: { op: present, field: revenue }
    - id: net-income-present
      severity: error
      description: Net income is required for an income statement extraction.
      supported: true
      rule: { op: present, field: net_income }
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.85
    fieldConfidence:
      entity_name: { minConfidence: 0.95, reviewOnBreach: true }
      period_end_date: { minConfidence: 0.95, reviewOnBreach: true }
      revenue: { minConfidence: 0.9, reviewOnBreach: true }
      net_income: { minConfidence: 0.9, reviewOnBreach: true }
  outputSchema: {}
